difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that two dualizing complexes on a locally Noetherian algebraic space differ by an invertible twist (statement lines 463-468). The proof (proof lines 469-483) defines the internal hom between the two complexes and verifies invertibility and the evaluation isomorphism by reduction to the corresponding statements over a ring via affine duality. H2: a complete short argument by local reduction.
